name: Watchlist opens for a signed-in reader
description: After signing in with email and password, the watchlist page shows its alerts card and its watched items card instead of sending the reader to sign in.

planSteps.description: In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in
Assert the URL path is no longer under /sign-in within 30 seconds
Assert the URL path is /watchlist and both the alerts card (data-testid watchlist-alerts) and the watched items card (data-testid watchlist-items) are shown
